title: Nobody Told Me: Hungry After Salad

hooks.A: Why am I starving one hour after a salad?!

lines.text: My first big grocery shop alone. I'm being so healthy. Lettuce, lettuce, and more lettuce.
Lunch: a giant bowl of leaves. I feel amazing.
One hour later... my stomach sounds like a monster.
Turns out, all those leaves fill your stomach with water and fiber, but they have very little energy.
So you feel full for a moment, and then that feeling fades fast.
It's like getting a giant delivery box, and it's mostly bubble wrap.
What keeps you full longer is protein, like eggs, chicken, beans, or yogurt.
And a little healthy fat, like avocado, nuts, or olive oil, slows down how fast your stomach empties.
So the trick isn't eating less salad. It's adding to it.
Leaves, plus a protein, plus a little fat. Same salad. Way less hangry.
Be honest. Am I the only one who thought lettuce was a full meal?
